info.title: ARGUS20 Collector API
info.description: Normative contract accompanying ARGUS20_TZ_SELAIN 3.0 (03.10.2026). Wire schema 1.1. Base path /api/collector (no /v1; version is carried in schema_version). M1: one Windows worker, job pinned to its worker, no automatic reassignment. IDs are opaque strings; new IDs are UUIDs. BrowserAction/ActionResult are internal worker contracts, not endpoints. Error object {code, detail, retryable, request_id} is a superset of the ARGUS base error format {code, detail}. Runtime enforces ownership, sequence, evidence, host approval (K7), participation (R8), budgets, field audit and state transitions beyond structural validation. Channel status (K3) is derived server-side from entity_type + binding + extraction_status; workers never set it.

servers.description: Production ARGUS (block 6). Until then the reference contract_server in gridex-argus-collector serves the same contract on loopback.

post.description: Idempotency by client_request_id within caller scope; different payload for accepted key => 409 idempotency_conflict. R8: every company needs participation_status confirmed/strong_historical with participation_claim_id, or owner_override with override_reason (SystemBearer only) => otherwise 422 participation_not_confirmed. One job per company per project unless rerun_reason is given.

post.description: Atomic claim of up to 8 jobs. Each claimed job carries run_id, lease generation, execution token, checkpoint (for continuation runs), known routes for its approved hosts and previously accepted contacts for freshness checks. Empty jobs array is valid.

default.description: Error; retry only when retryable=true. 429 respects Retry-After.

post.description: Match job/run/company ownership; verify hash and uncompressed size. 25 MiB HTML/DOM/JSON, 50 MiB documents/checkpoints, 10 MiB screenshots by default. Inert stored content. Idempotency by evidence_id and content hash.

default.description: Error; retry only when retryable=true. 429 respects Retry-After.

parameters.name: X-Execution-Token
parameters.description: Current lease token or drain-only delivery token returned by reconcile.

post.description: One job/run per request; ascending contiguous seq; suffix after a gap => sequence_gap. Atomic receipt and application; repeated accepted event ID/hash => duplicate. Observations require already uploaded evidence (evidence_missing) and a field_audit (field_audit_missing). Channel observations from hosts outside approved_hosts => host_not_approved. Server derives channel_status (K3) and writes model.called into model_call. job.finished requires last_content_seq = seq-1; with resumable gaps and remaining campaign budget the server schedules the next run (next_run_scheduled=true) instead of terminating the job.

default.description: Error; retry only when retryable=true. 429 respects Retry-After.

post.description: Only same owner worker/run. M1 expired lease remains pinned to worker. Renew generation preserving run/seq. Cancelled job returns drain_only token, not permission to browse. Never accepts unknown pending IDs as proof of ownership.

post.description: Optimistic state revision; client_request_id replay is idempotent. continue resumes from checkpoint under a new run; policy_patch may raise campaign limits (owner action, not automatic).

WorkerBearer.description: Worker-scoped token; cannot create/control arbitrary jobs.

SystemBearer.description: ARGUS internal or user authorization with collector-management permission; worker tokens not accepted.

Policy.description: Run limits (max_*) and campaign limits (campaign_*, max_runs, max_campaign_active_seconds) over all runs of one job. auto_continue schedules the next run while campaign budget remains.

CompanyInput.description: R8: participation_status confirmed/strong_historical requires participation_claim_id; owner_override requires override_reason and SystemBearer; otherwise 422 participation_not_confirmed. rerun_reason is required when the company already has a job in this project.

Coverage.description: Crawl completion (frontier_status, run_result_status) and coverage confirmation are independent. completed + unverified is a normal result; 100% coverage is only claimed with confirmation=verified_*.

source_kind.description: Server maps to snapshot.fetcher: http_html/json_response/embedded_data -> collector_http; browser_dom/screenshot/ocr -> collector_browser; document -> collector_document; checkpoint is not a snapshot.

FieldAudit.description: Every contact field found in the source must be mapped/extra/unresolved/empty_technical; dropped_contact_fields must be 0. Events without field_audit are rejected with field_audit_missing.

ModelUsage.description: Each call is written to ARGUS model_call (RULES E3). Local inference: local=true, cost_eur=0, tokens still counted.

HostApproval.description: K7: a host enters scope only with a basis; seed/owner_known_url may have evidence_id null, the other bases require evidence.

ChannelStatus.description: RULES K3. Derived by server from entity_type + binding + extraction_status (TZ SELAIN 3.0 §9.4).

Route.description: Successful navigation path that produced records. Speeds up re-runs; never raises coverage.

KnownContact.description: Previously accepted contacts of the company; the worker must report contact.freshness for each at run end.
